Title: Run OTel validation and council hardening pass.
Description: After OTel implementation, run repository validation/tests and perform a simulated LLM council review focused on privacy, performance, and operational safety. Remediate findings before completion. Acceptance criteria: validation scripts/tests pass, council review findings are documented, identified risks are either fixed or explicitly accepted with rationale, and implementation remains local-first with no mandatory external dependency.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Council/hardening task enforces explicit post-implementation risk review with remediation before sign-off.
